name: http_server
description: Start a simple local HTTP server to serve files or test webhooks. Useful for prototyping.

manual.overview: Use when you need to serve files locally for testing, prototypes, or webhook callbacks. Starts a simple HTTP server.

examples.description: Serve static build output on port 8080

tips: Use a non-privileged port (1024+); 8080 and 3000 are common
Server runs until timeout; useful for quick manual testing
Directory is relative to cwd unless absolute path
edge_cases: Port in use will fail; try another port
Server binds to all interfaces; avoid sharing sensitive dirs on shared networks
